name: docmd-kit-fixture
description: A small docmd site that uses the kit the way a real one does. CI builds it against a real docmd.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('.nav-generated.json', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('site', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && docmd-kit check-drawio && docmd build && docmd-kit check-drawio --built && docmd-kit check-nav
